newsitem.title: USA: Fire damages building near Lincoln Center.
newsitem.headline: Fire damages building near Lincoln Center.

text.p: Fire broke out Tuesday in a high-rise apartment building across from New York City's famous Lincoln Centre for the Performing Arts, causing several minor injuries, authorities said.

The blaze was first reported at 2:30 p.m., a spokeswoman for the Fire Department said. Smoke billowed and flames leaped from windows of the 42-story apartment building, located on Broadway at 64th Street, she said.
The fire started on the 28th floor of the building, which is known as One Lincoln Plaza, she said.
Most of those injured suffered from smoke inhalation, the Fire Department said. Most of the building was evacuated.
The cause of the fire was unknown and was under investigation, the department said.
